messages:
Alice (infra): kicking off canary rollout for sdk v10 to canary1 (10% traffic). watching paging + streaming metrics

deploy-bot: Deployment started: release/sdk-v10 -> canary1 at 2026-03-15T12:34:49Z

Ben (runtime): noted. i pushed the new framing handshake change earlier, should be backwards compatible but watch client hello variants

Carla (sre): alert: increased 5xx on paging endpoints from canary1 at +00:02

Jamie (oncall): i'm on pager, joining. can you paste the error pattern?

Maria (support): CS reports first ticket: customer #1145 seeing streaming disconnects after upgrade.

Ben (runtime): log snippet from canary1 node-7:
```
ERR handshake: unexpected frame type=0x12, client-proto=v3.5
stack: runtime/stream/handshake.go:142
```

Alice (infra): that frame type looks like the new optional chunked-handshake flag. should fall back but looks like clients are strict.

Carla (sre): spike in paging token errors too. trace id=tx-9a8b shows pagination cursor decode failures for v9 clients against v10 server.

Jamie (oncall): high impact for streaming customers; severity=P1 until mitigated. starting live mitigation checklist:
- isolate canary1
- route traffic away from canary1 to canary0
- evaluate kill-switch for feature flag `sdk_v10_proto`

Alice (infra): rerouting: `kubectl patch svc inference-canary --patch '{"spec":{"selector":{"canary":"0"}}}'` done. traffic diverted.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic shift complete: canary1 -> canary0. Health: degraded -> stabilizing.

Ben (runtime): i can push a hotfix to restore backward handshake compatibility, but need a quick rollback + FF kill to stop exposure.

Carla (sre): rolling back the rollout now. command: `deployctl rollback release/sdk-v10 --env=canary1`

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for release/sdk-v10 on canary1. ETA ~30s.

incident-bot: Incident created: paging-handshake-regression-3123456789. Assigned: Jamie (oncall), Carla (sre), Ben (runtime).

Jamie (oncall): @Maria can you notify affected customers with initial ETA and mitigation in progress? include workaround: pin to SDK v9.

Maria (support): sending templated notice to customers flagged by canary routing: "We are investigating increased streaming disconnects; we recommend pinning SDK to v9 until full fix. We'll update in 30 minutes." :email:

Ben (runtime): hotfix branch ready: `hotfix/compat-handshake` - change is to accept legacy frame type and fallback to v9 decode. testing locally then can push to canary0 if needed.

Alice (infra): putting global kill-switch on feature flag: `ffctl set sdk_v10_proto off --force`

deploy-bot: Feature flag `sdk_v10_proto` set to OFF (globally). All new connections will use legacy protocol.

Carla (sre): after FF OFF, error rate for paging cursor decodes dropped ~85% within 2 minutes. streaming disconnects also reduced but some clients still have half-open connections.

Jamie (oncall): good. opening a support triage doc for affected customers. any telemetry on how many unique customers hit canary1?

Alice (infra): approximate: 23 customers, ~0.03% of total traffic. 7 customers reported noticeable impacts via CS.

Maria (support): logged tickets: #1145, #1146, #1150, #1152, #1154, #1160, #1163. prioritizing 1145 & 1150 (enterprise).

Ben (runtime): quick patch landed to hotfix branch and promoted to canary0 for verification. `git rev-parse hotfix/compat-handshake` -> `f3b2c9a`.

deploy-bot: Promote complete: hotfix/compat-handshake -> canary0. Health checks passing.

Carla (sre): monitoring: paging token errors back down to baseline. will keep canary0 traffic pinned while we validate.

Jamie (oncall): handing off to Carla for postmortem + RCA. I'll stay until first-hour update done. tagging in SRE lead for follow-up.

Carla (sre): next steps for RCA: capture request traces, reproduce with v9 client, add regression test, and ensure protocol negotiation explicitly supported in handshake. scheduling postmortem doc.

Maria (support): update sent to customers: "Issue mitigated by rolling back one canary and disabling SDK v10 protocol flag. Engineers are working on permanent fix; we'll notify when SDK v10 is safe to re-enable."

Ben (runtime): root cause hypothesis: a guard in the new handshake code required clients to advertise optional chunked flag; some older clients send a legacy hello that triggered a non-fatal but unhandled code path, causing cursor decode mismatch when mixing token formats. fix will explicitly accept legacy hello or treat unknown flags as advisory.

Alice (infra): lesson: toggleable protocol changes must have a hard server-side fallback path + canary clients must be more isolated. adding a pre-rollout checklist item.

Carla (sre): closing incident channel for active mitigation. creating postmortem ticket INC-3123456789-PM and will add timeline, impact, and follow-up actions.

Jamie (oncall): thanks all. leaving note in oncall handoff: monitoring for any regression when we re-enable ff; if reenable, do canary0 -> small subset with strict client-version mapping. :clipboard:

Maria (support): marking impacted customers with follow-up syncs scheduled. will confirm when all tickets have owner and ETA.

incident-bot: Incident paging-handshake-regression-3123456789 status: mitigated -> monitoring.

Carla (sre): last check: 5xx for paging endpoints near baseline, streaming disconnects low. moving to monitoring state. end of thread.
